title: haplopappus lanceolatus
intro: Haplopappus lanceolatus, commonly known as Rocky Mountain woolly beardtongue, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to the mountainous regions of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Haplopappus lanceolatus include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
